body: Utilities Commission - Special Meeting Prop 218 Hearing
agenda_text:
PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, AUGUST 27, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  ADMINISTRATION BLDG. ASSEMBLY ROOM, 7:00 PM

Kevin Scott, President  Gina Maguire, Commissioner
Gloria Cordero, Vice President  Al Austin II, Commissioner
Charles Parkin, Secretary

B. Anatole Falagán, General Manager  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney

  SPECIAL MEETING

  PROP 218 HEARING

  Members of the public have the option to email comments to commission@lbutilities.org

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-55921  Consider the timely written objections by ratepayers to the proposed water and
  sewer rate schedules for Fiscal Year 2026-2027 and the corresponding Long
  Beach Public Utilities Department’s responses, and make the determination to
  proceed with the Proposition 218 protest hearing pursuant to the requirements of
  Government Code Section 53759.1.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

HEARING

2.  26-55922  Recommendation to receive supporting documentation into the record
  on the proposed increase to the City’s Water and Sewer Rates for
  Fiscal Year 2026-2027; receive public comment pursuant to Proposition
  218; and, in the absence of a majority protest, conclude the public hearing.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Utilities Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Board.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION MINUTES

  ADMINISTRATION BLDG. ASSEMBLY ROOM, 7:00 PM

Kevin Scott, President  Gina Maguire, Commissioner
Gloria Cordero, Vice President  Al Austin II, Commissioner
Charles Parkin, Secretary

B. Anatole Falagán, General Manager  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney

  FINISHED AGENDA & DRAFT MINUTES

  SPECIAL MEETING

  PROP 218 HEARING

CALL TO ORDER

At 7:00 PM, President Scott called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Austin, Maguire, Parkin, Cordero, Scott

Anatole Falagan, General Manager, Utilities Department, spoke.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-55921  Consider the timely written objections by ratepayers to the proposed water and
  sewer rate schedules for Fiscal Year 2026-2027 and the corresponding Long
  Beach Public Utilities Department’s responses, and make the determination to
  proceed with the Proposition 218 protest hearing pursuant to the requirements of
  Government Code Section 53759.1.

  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney, spoke; and provided a PowerPoint
  presentation.

  A motion was made by Secretary Parkin, seconded by Commissioner Austin,
  to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  5  Austin, Maguire, Parkin, Cordero, Scott
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None
